list.title: Tilta credit facility
list.intro:
Credit Facility is a new, flexible way to shop on our website, giving you a spending limit to make purchases with convenient 30-day payment terms.
Here’s how it works:
  1. Request a Credit Facility: Fill in your business info, and when approved, you’ll receive a spending limit – that you can use to make purchases on our site
  2. No prepayments: Use your credit facility to buy the items you want without having to pay upfront. Simply select the “Rechnungskauf” option at checkout.
  3. Pay Later: You only have to pay 30 days after your purchases are shipped. We will send you a reminder a couple of days before the date.

create.title: Request credit facility
create.intro: You can apply for a credit limit to use Invoice Payments. After you are approved, you will have a site-wide credit limit, allowing you to delay payment for the orders that fit into your limit. Requesting a credit limit from us does not affect your credit rating.
